title: Parse coordination gaps: timeout, lock coverage, path canonicalization
description:
Follow-up from codex adversarial review of sutra/21. Three gaps in the scheduler-wedge fix:

1. **Parse timeout is not real.** parse_workspace is blocking sync work (filesystem + tree-sitter + SQLite) with no await points. tokio::time::timeout wraps it but can't preempt it — a genuinely hung parse holds the per-workspace guard indefinitely and never records the failed snapshot sentinel.

2. **MCP parse entry points bypass the daemon lock.** sutra_parse and sutra_add_root call pipeline::parse_workspace directly, not through the daemon's per-workspace Mutex. User-triggered parses can race the scheduler/watcher on the same DB.

3. **Overlap check is lexical only.** roots_overlap compares raw PathBufs via starts_with. Symlinks, relative paths, or non-canonical spellings bypass the ancestor/descendant check, reopening the watcher fan-out race.

acceptance_criteria.text: Parse timeout actually aborts hung parses — use spawn_blocking or a cooperative cancellation boundary so tokio can enforce the deadline
Failed-snapshot sentinel is recorded from outside the blocked work when deadline fires, not from inside the parse
All parse entry points (sutra_parse, sutra_add_root, scheduler, watcher) route through a shared parse coordinator/lock
Workspace roots are canonicalized before storage and overlap comparison — symlinks, relative paths, and non-canonical spellings are normalized
Tests: symlink and relative-path workspace registration rejected by overlap check
Tests: concurrent parse from MCP and scheduler on same workspace does not produce DB lock errors

implementation_plan:
Three-wave fix:

**Wave 1-3 (signature + coordination):** Converted `parse_workspace` and `parse_changed_files` from async to sync `fn` with `cancel: &AtomicBool` param (cooperative cancellation). Added `ParseCoordinator` newtype in `pipeline.rs`. Daemon uses `spawn_blocking` + real timeout + cancel flag. MCP tools (`sutra_parse`, `sutra_add_root`, `sutra_status`) now acquire shared coordinator lock before parsing.

**Wave 4 (canonicalization):** `roots_overlap` canonicalizes paths before comparison. `register_workspace` (MCP) and `add_workspace` (REST) canonicalize paths at entry.

**Wave 5 (tests):** Added `test_reject_symlink_overlap`, `test_reject_dotdot_overlap`, `test_parse_cancellation`.
execution_record: All three gaps fixed. 224 tests pass, no new clippy warnings. 13 files changed across src/ and tests/. New tests: test_reject_symlink_overlap, test_reject_dotdot_overlap, test_parse_cancellation.
